snippet.title: Tom Holland Reacts to Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey Trailer
snippet.description:
Join this channel to get early access to episodes, ad-free watching, and priority access to our live events:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCUYK0BJZF3yNb2fw1EdAXUQ/join

Tom Holland reacts to the trailers for Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey, unpacking the myth, history, and symbolism behind Homer’s great epic. From the fall of Troy and the Trojan Horse to Odysseus’s desperate journey home to Ithaca, Tom explores why this ancient story is such a perfect fit for Nolan’s fascination with time, memory, fate, and fractured narratives. He also looks at the film’s major characters, including Penelope, Telemachus, Athena, Antinous, Agamemnon, and the Cyclops Polyphemus, while explaining what each reveals about the world of the Odyssey. With its IMAX scale, mythic action, and one of the greatest stories ever told, Nolan’s adaptation could be one of the cinematic events of the year.

Book your tickets to Christopher Nolan’s the Odyssey, in cinemas July 17th.

snippet.title: Jux Ft Mbosso - Kipepeo (Official Video)
snippet.description:
🦋 KIPEPEO (Official Video) 🦋

The official music video for “Kipepeo” is finally here.

Performed by Juma Jux featuring Mbosso, this visual masterpiece is directed by Fole X and beautifully captures a timeless love story through the breathtaking landscapes of Zanzibar and Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

Featuring stunning lead models from Tanzania and South Africa, Kipepeo celebrates African beauty, culture, and the power of love without borders.

🎬 Directed by: Fole X
📍 Shot in: Zanzibar & Dar Es Salaam, Tanzania
🌍 Main Video Models: Tanzania 🇹🇿 & South Africa 🇿🇦
🎵 Produced by: S2Kizzy

Special thanks to everyone who made this project possible and to all our fans around the world for the incredible support.

Subscribe, share, and join us in spreading the magic of #Kipepeo.

🦋❤️

#Kipepeo #Jux #Mbosso

snippet.title: Billy Joel - Piano Man (Lyrics)
snippet.description:
🎵 Billy Joel - Piano Man (Lyrics)

⏬ Stream “Piano Man” by "Billy Joel" here: https://billyjoel.lnk.to/listenYD

🎤 Song Lyrics: Billy Joel - Piano Man

[Verse 1]
It's nine o'clock on a Saturday
The regular crowd shuffles in
There's an old man sittin' next to me
Makin' love to his tonic and gin
He says, "Son, can you play me a memory?
I'm not really sure how it goes
But it's sad, and it's sweet, and I knew it complete
When I wore a younger man's clothes"

[Refrain]
La, la-la, di-dee-da
La-la, di-dee-da da-dum

[Chorus]
Sing us a song, you're the piano man
Sing us a song tonight
Well, we're all in the mood for a melody
And you've got us feelin' alright

[Verse 2]
Now John at the bar is a friend of mine
He gets me my drinks for free
And he's quick with a joke, or to light up your smoke
But there's someplace that he'd rather be
He says, "Bill, I believe this is killing me"
As the smile ran away from his face
"Well, I'm sure that I could be a movie star
If I could get out of this place"

[Refrain]
Oh, la, la-la, di-dee-da
La-la, di-dee-da da-dum

[Verse 3]
Now Paul is a real estate novelist
Who never had time for a wife
And he's talkin' with Davy, who's still in the navy
And probably will be for life
And the waitress is practicing politics
As the businessmen slowly get stoned
Yes, they're sharing a drink they call loneliness
But it's better than drinkin' alone

[Piano Solo]

[Chorus]
Sing us a song, you're the piano man
Sing us a song tonight
Well, we're all in the mood for a melody
And you've got us feelin' alright

[Verse 4]
It's a pretty good crowd for a Saturday
And the manager gives me a smile
'Cause he knows that it's me they've been comin' to see
To forget about life for a while
And the piano, it sounds like a carnival
And the microphone smells like a beer
And they sit at the bar and put bread in my jar
And say, "Man, what are you doin' here?"

[Refrain]
Oh, la, la-la, di-dee-da
La-la, di-dee-da da-dum

[Chorus]
Sing us a song, you're the piano man
Sing us a song tonight
Well, we're all in the mood for a melody
And you've got us feelin' alright

...........................................................................................

snippet.title: "Star-Spangled Banner" - Marsh Family adaptation of the US National Anthem for 250th 4th of July Day
snippet.description:
Wishing a very happy #4thJuly to our many friends and supporters in the USA. To mark the 250th anniversary today, we've re-adapted the British popular 18th-century song "The Anacreontic Song" which became the US national anthem the #StarSpangledBanner after Francis Scott Key wrote powerful and moving words to describe the survival of a fort under bombardment during the War of 1812 (against the British). 

We've taken as our topic for the re-adaptation the current state of the United States in 2026 as seen against its majestic history, using the metaphor of a ship sailing. Lyrics below, with nods to some of the great speeches and moments in American history, and with hopes that the current distortion of its values and direction will not endure, but be another storm to pass through. 

Downloadable as a track: https://themarshfamily.bandcamp.com/track/star-spangled-banner ❤️🇺🇸🎶

___________________________ 

Order our new album "Hollow Chapters" (came out 27 March): 
DIGITAL: https://orcd.co/hollowchapters 
PHYSICAL: CDs or LPs: https://themarshfamily.bandcamp.com/album/hollow-chapters

___________________________ 

Support us here: 
- PayPal to leave us a tip jar: https://paypal.me/marshfamilysongs 
- Patreon for ongoing support & bonuses: https://www.patreon.com/marshfamilysongs 

Find our other channels here: https://linktr.ee/marshfamilysongs 

Follow us here: 
- https://www.marshfamilysongs.com 
- https://www.facebook.com/MarshFamilySongs/ 
- https://www.instagram.com/marshfamilysongs/ 
- https://twitter.com/MarshSongs 
- https://www.threads.net/@marshfamilysongs 
- https://www.tiktok.com/@marshfamilysongs 
- https://bsky.app/profile/marshfamilysongs.bsky.social 
- https://open.spotify.com/artist/6AYmbCwi92V29y69lkRkRa 

___________________________ 

LYRICS

O say, can you see, through the dusk’s ebbing light
What so proudly once sailed on a tide fit for dreaming?
Whose design from her start, bearing freedom and right
O’er the dark waves seems lost, in the storm’s ghastly screaming
And the rocks rip and tear, the old timbers impaired
Ne’er proofed ‘gainst the might that the kraken could bear
O say does that star-spangled banner yet wave?
O’er the land of the free and the home of the brave

From the shore dimly seen over history’s deep,
Linger ancestral ghosts who had bled for each passage
For twelve score and ten years, o’er the towering steep
Out of slavery’s throes, every era less savage
Now the shipwreck falls hard, but atop, torn and scarred
‘Cross the violent vast sea flutters life, liberty: 
O say does that star-spangled banner yet wave?
O’er the land of the free and the home of the brave

gru is a grouchy, quick-witted, and cynical supervillain and the boss of the minions, who also serves as a secret agent in order to fight other supervillains. his adoption of three orphan girls named margo, edith and agnes propels his story arc from malevolent supervillain to reformed parent.

bowser, sometimes known as king koopa or king bowser, is the main antagonist of the mario franchise. he is a large, powerful, fire-breathing koopa who leads the koopa troop, an evil kingdom of turtle-like creatures, and has been the arch-nemesis of mario since his debut in super mario bros created by nintendo. he has repeatedly kidnapped or attempted to kidnap princess peach with the ultimate goal of defeating mario and taking over the mushroom kingdom. he has also attempted to conquer other lands, such as the mushroom world, dinosaur land and many more. now bowser is in a rap battle against gru.
